title: Empowering Capacitive Devices: Harnessing Transfer Learning for Enhanced Data-Driven Optimization
summary: A research code repository for a paper on transfer learning applied to data-driven optimization of capacitive devices, including training scripts and notebooks. The requirements/environment files pin sdv, ctgan, rdt, sdmetrics, and copulas, but no call site in the codebase was found using them.
evidence: requirements.txt: sdv==1.9.0, ctgan==0.8.0, rdt==1.9.1, sdmetrics==0.13.0, copulas==0.9.2 with no matching code usage found
needs: No code evidence of actual SDV usage was found; dependencies are declared but never invoked in the harvested material, so it's unclear whether they were used for imputation/synthetic data generation or left unused.
